scope: Fixed target model, TP8 vocab shards, M07-M09. Frozen greedy and optional prompt-score scopes priced separately.

logprob_rank_counterexample.scope: The reference gather selects topK and counts >= from the normalized score tensor. Even ideal real normalization followed by FP32 rounding can create ties. Preserve original normalization rounding and native tie selection, or maintain an explicit alternate numeric contract. Raw-score ranking alone is insufficient. Count locally after applying the original common normalization and rounding, then sum rank statistics. Nonlocal normalization accuracy, full vocab results and TopK boundary ties need independent handling.

frozen_greedy.method: On each active wave grant the maximum local credit over all active ranks separately before and after the same target projection. Propagate both in full to every client through its own producing wave; recompute each endpoint. Greedy only; no time inside the projection, subsequent DSpark or CPU publication. Brackets also grant necessary work and barriers; the named scenario keeps communication, HcPost, raw TensorMove and ArgMax, but grants all five collapse/norm tasks, the head input check/index and dense score layout/copies as free.

enabled_prompt.wording: Cold, scored token-ID prompt; positive rows summed over chunks. The primary one-pass scenario preserves the ordinary one-active-prefill pattern; its dense gather size exceeds the measured range and reuses a measured effective rate. Original no-score request lengths only. Both sides use identical hidden rows, GEMM shape and weights per modeled chunk; no weight reuse/overlap or reduced MAC credit. Source does not fix 128/256: these are two scoring schedules around the available 34-67 MB gather samples. Large-transfer rate includes waiting. Small-packet proxy adds its measured startup and logical full-packet transfer. 1% requires enabled-path TTFT <=100 times the actual net ms. Negative increments are possible. No enabled-run latency denominator or branch frequency observed.

guards.disabled: Zero prompt-score credit on the frozen completion client and six ordinary inputs.
guards.rows: Empty registry, no scheduled tokens, tokenless prompt embeddings and zero remaining predictors produce no prompt scoring. Use actual remaining positions at each chunk. Token i predicts token i+1. Never assume a cached prefix incurred full recomputation.
guards.finite: K=0 still returns selected score and its >= rank; finite K>0 retains selected token as first field, even if also in top-K. Finite candidate must preserve input BF16, output FP32, prior transform, native tie selection, exceptional row handling and global token IDs.
guards.normalized: First exchange global max and the owner target score, second sum the shifted exponentials, third merge local K tuples and >= counts evaluated after original common FP32 normalization. Changing FP32 reduction order, ties or Top-K boundary may change results. Exact implementation or fallback essential.
guards.raw: Raw/processed logits skip normalization for prompt token scoring; exchange target then local K and counts. Prompt scoring skips generation processors. Standalone dense logits to other readers must remain available.
guards.all_vocab: -1 maps to V. Dense output and order must be retained; compact estimates inapplicable.
guards.scheduling: Consumers still receive original CPU slices after nonblocking copies and completion sync. No saved sync, D2H, Python, sampling RNG, projection or changed feature frequency credited.
